raw_graphql_pull_request.body: # PR type - [x] Bug Fix - [ ] New Feature - [x] Document Updates - [ ] More Models or Datasets Support # PR information Fixes #10374 When lazy encoding fails before and after a checkpoint, recreating `LazyLLMDataset` resets its shared fallback cursor. Resuming at the correct sampler position can therefore return different replacement rows than uninterrupted training. Derive bounded, non-repeating fallback candidates from a dataset seed and the requested index, only after the first encoding failure. This removes access-history-dependent selection without changing checkpoint code. Keep strict mode, the total attempt limit, valid-row access and exclusion of the initial failed row. Document the deterministic candidate behavior and add resume/access-order regression tests. The same failing index uses the same candidate order across epochs. Different failing indices may still share a replacement. Determinism assumes unchanged dataset order, seed and encoding outcomes; the old replacement sequence is intentionally not preserved. AI assistance: Co-authored-by: GPT 6 Astra ## Experiment results - Checkout validation: `python -m pytest tests/general/test_lazy_dataset_retries.py -q` — 8 passed, 9 subtests passed; `pre-commit run --all-files` — passed. - The same class was applied directly to installed Swift 4.4.2 and its tests passed there as well. - GPU integration reproduction uses Magnus/Megatron Bridge with Qwen3-0.6B-Base, 2×B200, BF16, 8 steps, global batch 4, seed 42, lazy tokenization, no packing/streaming/shuffle, and zero DataLoader workers. Rows 2 and 20 exceed max_length=256. Compare uninterrupted training with an independent run stopped after the synchronous step-4 checkpoint and resumed in a fresh process. - Before (archived 2026-10-14 run): first post-resume fallback changes the step-6 batch; maximum loss difference `0.0024992227554321289`. - After (final `2**30` seed-range implementation): all 32 batch pairs and all 16 per-rank scalar-loss byte comparisons match exactly; maximum logged loss difference is 0 across steps 1–8. Both ranks resume at step 4 / consumed_samples 16. No tolerance or fallback-state restoration is used. - This is an integration reproduction through Magnus, not a full native Swift CLI or multi-worker validation. Each plot compares uninterrupted/resumed runs within one implementation. The plots show all eight steps; steps 1–4 of the interrupted/resumed curve come from the independent interrupted run. # Checklist - [x] I have linked the related issue above, if there is one. - [x] I have reviewed and understand every changed line, and I can explain how the change works and why it is correct. - [x] I have run the relevant tests or reproductions locally, and included the commands and results above (if applicable). - [x] I am responsible for the content of this PR, regardless of how it was produced.

@@ -514,6 +514,7 @@ Vera使用`target_modules`、`target_regex`、`modules_to_save`三个参数，
 - packing_num_proc: packing的进程数，默认为1。需要注意的是，不同的`packing_num_proc`，最终形成的packed数据集是不同的。（该参数在流式packing时不生效）。通常不需要修改该值，packing速度远快于tokenize速度。
 - packing_strategy: packing 算法，可选为'binpack'和'sequential'，默认为'binpack'。'binpack'使用 best-fit-decreasing 装箱（会按长度重排样本）；'sequential'使用保序的贪心装箱（next-fit：仅维护一个开放 pack，放不下即 flush），按输入顺序逐条装箱，使样本顺序与每个 pack 的边界跟随顺序采样器（建议配合 packing_num_proc=1 以保证全局顺序）。
 - lazy_tokenize: 是否使用lazy_tokenize。若该参数设置为False，则在训练之前对所有的数据集样本进行tokenize（多模态模型则包括从磁盘中读取图片）。该参数默认为None，在LLM训练中默认为False，而MLLM训练默认为True，节约内存。
+  - 对非流式的 lazy 数据集，`strict=False` 时编码失败的样本会被其他样本替代。候选顺序由 `data_seed` 和请求索引确定，不依赖之前的访问顺序；固定数据顺序、种子和编码行为时，断点恢复不会改变替代选择。同一失败索引在不同 epoch 也使用相同的候选顺序；不同失败索引仍可能选中同一替代样本。
   - 注意：若你要进行图像的数据增强，你需要将lazy_tokenize（或streaming）设置为True，并修改Template类中的encode方法。
 - use_logits_to_keep: 通过在`forward`中根据labels传入logits_to_keep，减少无效logits的计算与存储，从而减少显存占用并加快训练速度。默认为None，进行自动选择。
 - acc_strategy: 训练和验证时计算acc的策略。可选为`seq`和`token`级别的acc，默认为`token`。

@@ -526,6 +526,7 @@ Training arguments include the [base arguments](#base-arguments), [Seq2SeqTraine
 - packing_num_proc: Number of processes for packing, default is 1. Note that different values of `packing_num_proc` will result in different packed datasets. (This parameter does not take effect during streaming packing). Usually there is no need to modify this value, as packing speed is much faster than tokenization speed.
 - packing_strategy: Packing algorithm, one of 'binpack' and 'sequential', default is 'binpack'. 'binpack' uses best-fit-decreasing bin packing (which reorders samples by length); 'sequential' uses order-preserving greedy packing (next-fit: a single open pack, flushed when the next sample doesn't fit), keeping samples in input order so the sample order and pack boundaries follow a sequential sampler (use `packing_num_proc=1` for a single global ordering).
 - lazy_tokenize: Whether to use lazy tokenization. If set to `False`, all dataset samples will be tokenized (and for multimodal models, images will be loaded from disk) before training begins. Default is `None`: in LLM training, it defaults to `False`; in MLLM training, it defaults to `True` to save memory.
+  - For non-streaming lazy datasets, encoding failures use replacement samples when `strict=False`. The candidate order depends on `data_seed` and the requested index, not previous accesses. With unchanged dataset order, seed, and encoding behavior, resuming does not change replacement selection. The same failing index also uses the same candidate order across epochs; different failing indices may still select the same replacement.
   - Note: If you want to perform image data augmentation, you need to set `lazy_tokenize` (or `streaming`) to True and modify the `encode` method in the Template class.
 - use_logits_to_keep: Pass `logits_to_keep` in the `forward` method based on labels to reduce the computation and storage of unnecessary logits, thereby reducing memory usage and accelerating training. The default is `None`, which enables automatic selection.
 - acc_strategy: Strategy for calculating accuracy during training and validation. Options are `seq`-level and `token`-level accuracy, with `token` as the default.
